title: jeremiah babe: TRUMP WARNS OF COMING GREAT DEPRESSION IT'S ALREADY BEGUN- MARGIN DEBT
description:
This jeremiah babe recap starts with his reported $320 grocery trip, including routine shopping and hurricane extras. We follow his food-price concerns, his view that oil understates war and storm risks, his AI-bubble warning and Treasury-support suspicions. Next come his criticism of Trump’s investment optics—not an allegation of illegality—his bullish gold outlook, his metals-for-property plan, and his warning about a deficit near $2 trillion and declining living standards. Forecasts and suspicions remain his views, not established facts.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
